title: The Good Life | Gulf Front 30A Retreat | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Discover The Good Life, a Gulf Front designer townhome near Alys Beach with a private beach, bikes, and designer interiors.
description_expanded: The Good Life Features - Gulf front Townhome with picturesque views throughout home - Building has private beach entrance steps from the Gulf facing patio - Beach Chair Rentals available March through October at the private beach - avoid rows and rows of chairs. Setup is only a small number of chairs in front of building. - Enjoy 2 Taxi bikes with your reservation - great location for biking to 30A hotspots! - Full kitchen with stainless steel Bosch appliances - Drip and Keurig Coffee Maker - Breakfast bar seating for 5 - Super comfy outdoor furniture on the covered patio and covered balcony. - Fully renovated spa baths with walk-in showers - Updated gulf facing deck including outdoor bistro table dining, lounge chairs, and outdoor shower - SmartTV with YouTube TV and WIFI throughout the home - Dedicated parking for 1 vehicle directly in front of home - Close to Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach. Hop on a bike and peddle down 30A to upscale shopping and dining in under 10 minutes. - 7-minute drive to the largest Publix in America. Pre-order Pub Subs for beach picnics! - Incredible Gulf views from the King Suite and throughout the 1st floor. - Bike rentals, grocery delivery, beach chair service, and more concierge services available. - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Designer Gulf Front Townhome at Booth Bay! Everything is renovated in the home including spa baths with walk-in showers, smart TVs, and glass balcony wall for unobstructed views. Check out the video of the view! Located close to shopping and dining in Alys Beach, and only 2 minutes to The Big Chill! Hop on the bike and explore all 30A has to offer.

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
